notes:
BOSS: every buy of BOSS hits the boss, every sell heals it, and a daily ability written by the IMD swarm scales both. Pair BOSS/IMD. Hook fee 2.5% in IMD on all four swap shapes (1.5% to the pot, 1% to the treasury, which the keeper claims to pay the swarm's daily jobs in IMD). Pot split on a kill: 10% stays as the next boss's seed, then 50% to the killer and 50% by damage among wallets that did not sell. Payouts are pull-only (claimKill, claimDamage, claimTreasury). Abilities: STATICCALL with 50k gas, multipliers clamped to [0.25x, 4x], 1x on any failure; a swap reverts if too little gas is left to give the ability its 50k. An ability is queued only with an IMD oracle EIP-712 attestation answering id*2+1 to a fixed question about AbilityBoard.pending(), then waits 12 h; at most one activation per 24 h. No owner, no setters, no proxy, no DELEGATECALL, no SELFDESTRUCT. Hook flags 0x20CC.

CONSTRUCTOR. 9 flat static args, no tuple: (1) $poolManager; (2) $token, the BossToken; (3) the keeper, a literal EOA on purpose (not $owner): the only address that can propose abilities on the AbilityBoard, and the receiver of the 1% treasury; (4) the AbilityBoard, deployed on mainnet before the launch with keeper() equal to arg 3 (otherwise the constructor reverts InvalidConfig); (5) the IMD oracle EIP-712 signer; (6) questionHash, the hash IMD assigns to the fixed ability question for this board (docs/ORACLE-QUESTION.md, request body in tools/oracle-check.mjs); (7) the first boss's HP in IMD wei (500 IMD); (8) |tick| of the launch price, 129000 (2,500 IMD opening cap over 1,000,000,000 BOSS); (9) the paired currency, IMD. Oracle panel 21 / quorum 15 are source constants (PANEL_SIZE, QUORUM) that match the oracle request.

POOL PIN. Args 8-9 plus the source constants LP_FEE = 12500 and TICK_SPACING = 60 pin the pool key: beforeInitialize refuses any other paired currency (WrongPairedCurrency), LP fee (WrongLPFee) or tick spacing (WrongTickSpacing), a second pool (PoolAlreadyInitialized), and a start price more than 300 ticks (LAUNCH_TICK_TOLERANCE) away from the launch tick for the ordering it sees (WrongStartingPrice). The LP fee and the tick spacing are not constructor args, so pool.fee and pool.tickSpacing must equal LP_FEE and TICK_SPACING. 12500 is the LP fee tier the mainnet hook launch policy admits: the pool charges 1.25% on every trade, on top of the hook's 2.5%.

INITIAL PRICE AND ORDERING. pool.initialPrice is the sqrtPriceX96 of tick -129000, for BOSS sorting below IMD (BOSS is currency0). If BOSS sorts above IMD, the matching value is 50111677533496076234078224273595 (tick +129000). An opening cap of 2,500 IMD is about tick -128,999 (or +128,999), inside the 300-tick tolerance in both orderings, also when snapped to the 60 spacing.

ATOMIC LAUNCH. The first valid initialize binds the hook to its pool, so deploying the hook and initializing the pool must happen in one sequence nobody can slip into.
